entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Benedikt Rejt was a leading medieval architect in Bohemia, today's Czech Republic. He built Vladislav Hall (1497–1500) in Prague Castle, St. Barbara's Church, Kutná Hora, and other buildings in a late Gothic and early Renaissance style.
